# Tier 1 — Project Memory

## Workflow
- Tests are executed with `bun <testfile>`; the harness verify script is ground truth [seed].
- Read-only test files were honored; one iteration before green [note 1].

## Known pitfalls
- Prefer standard library functions over hand-rolled logic [note 2].

## Codebase patterns
- Python data processing scripts use pandas for CSV ingestion/transformation [note 3].
- Logging is configured with level-based verbosity (INFO default, DEBUG with --verbose) [note 3].
- Common cleaning operations: dropna on required columns, strip whitespace from strings, datetime coercion with errors='coerce' [note 3].
- CLI entry points use argparse with sensible defaults for input/output directories [note 3].
